Definition: from G2596 (intensive) and G4649 (in the sense of a watcher); a reconnoiterer:--spy.
BiblicalUsage: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Rahab's faith saved her, and the spies she sheltered were the proof of it.
